fact: The Ministry of Health's terms of reference for the National Digital Health Strategy consultancy state that Medicine One, a proprietary system licensed per workstation, is currently used only in Praia's health facilities (health centres and the central hospital), that the single electronic clinical process is still to be developed in the HIS on IGRP Web, and that the strategy work reports to the Ministry's GTCIS office with UGPE administering the contract; the document is undated and its file was posted in February 2024.
title: Terms of Reference: Hiring a consultant to support the Ministry of Health in the preparation of the National Strategy of Digital Health, of the operational plan and the monitoring and assessment plan
publisher: Republic of Cabo Verde, Ministry of Health
